name: Reasonix
tagline: Open-source coding agent for the terminal, desktop app, browser and VS Code.
description: A local coding agent that reads a project, edits files and runs commands, with configurable permission levels and a plan mode that waits for approval before starting. It ships as a CLI/TUI, the Reasonix Studio desktop app, a local web interface and a VS Code extension, and supports MCP servers and plugins.

pricing.notes: Open source under MIT; you pay the model provider directly.
